absa_quad_triplet_v1.loss_policy: implicit ABSA configs record excluded event targets in sentivent_omitted_targets

absa_raw_line_v2.loss_policy: renders implicit ABSA sentence annotations as ASTE token-index triplet lines and ASQP character-span quad lines; each source line-boundary code point becomes one space so character offsets remain width preserving (CRLF becomes two spaces); event sentiment targets and non-sentence-local spans are excluded to match ABSA baseline files

canonical_loss_preserving.loss_policy: preserves parsed graph structure in normalized internal audit tables

dygiepp_upstream_v1.loss_policy: projects events to the upstream DyGIE++ schema with document-level token indices; multi-token or discontinuous SENTiVENT triggers are reduced to the first trigger token because DyGIE++ event triggers are single-token

legacy_clean_duplicate_documents.description: Selects one public graph per document with the legacy duplicate annotation policy while retaining all annotation graphs in the canonical graph snapshot.
legacy_clean_duplicate_documents.loss_policy: removes duplicate annotation graphs from public views

legacy_dygiepp_v1.loss_policy: DyGIE++ projection with fixture and full-corpus parity after normalizing the vendored exporter's unstable argument order

legacy_gts_v1.loss_policy: legacy GTS sentence rows with BIO target/opinion tags; fixture and full-corpus parity pass after normalizing non-semantic triple UID/order

legacy_implicit_polar_v1.loss_policy: legacy implicit-polarity instance rows with fixture and full-corpus parity after normalizing non-semantic target span order

llm_schema_structured_v1.loss_policy: wraps task rows as internal schema-constrained LLM eval prompts

omnievent_compatible_v1.loss_policy: OmniEvent-style sentence/window projection with positive events and entities from the canonical graph; negative triggers are not generated and joint sentiment rows use SENTiVENT-specific SentiPol relation records

oneie_compatible_v1.loss_policy: OneIE-style sentence/window projection derived from the canonical graph; event triggers and arguments preserve legacy role grouping where possible, while sentiment rows use SENTiVENT-specific SentiPol relation records

sentivent.sentivent_unified_document.v1.loss_policy: projects document-level joint event and sentiment annotations into a compact model-facing JSON shape with canonical referents resolved

sentivent.sentivent_unified_document_con.loss_policy: fills discontinuous annotation spans to the smallest covering continuous range for tools that cannot consume multi-part spans

sentivent.sentivent_unified_document_wit.loss_policy: keeps the default resolved document-level spans and adds inline canonical-referent evidence on resolved arguments and targets

sentivent.sentivent_unified_sentence.v1.loss_policy: projects joint event and sentiment annotations into one row per source sentence, with cross-sentence arguments, targets, and relations omitted from the sentence window

sentivent.sentivent_unified_sentence_con.loss_policy: fills retained sentence-local discontinuous spans to continuous ranges without crossing sentence boundaries

sentivent.sentivent_unified_sentence_wit.loss_policy: adds inline canonical-reference evidence only when both original and canonical mentions are inside the same sentence row

task_hf_structured_v1.loss_policy: projects graph annotations into internal document, sentence, and token task rows for downstream converter reuse

textee_event_v1.loss_policy: sentence windows mark out-of-window arguments in sentivent_omitted_arguments

token_label_bio_v1.loss_policy: projects graph spans into sentence-level BIO token-label rows; overlapping labels are preserved in label_sets and label_conflicts while labels and ner_tags expose one deterministic sequence-tagging label per token

uie_spot_asoc_v1.loss_policy: renders task rows as UIE spot-association targets with official tokens/entity/relation/event/task fields plus id-rich gold JSON
